description:
Change what a segment is. Every call previews first: when no
rendered image or clip would be lost it runs; otherwise it changes
nothing and returns what would be lost. Show the user, then call again
with confirm=true.

combine: merge with a neighboring segment. The kept segment's renders
stay, retimed to the combined length, but go stale: its prompts are
rewritten for the combined narration, so render it again after. The
other's are deleted (the preview names it).

change_type: to an image, real photo, B-roll (both fetched) or overlay
segment. Clips and talking heads come from render action=animate.
keep_image turns a clip back into its image, keeping the render. A
change between an image, real photo and B-roll keeps the prompts;
render the image again.

rewrite: an AI rewrite of the prompts from feedback; render the image
and clip again after. For exact text, use segment_edit set_prompts.

combine, rewrite and a change to or from an overlay segment write
prompts in the background, and a change to a real photo or B-roll with
no searches yet writes its searches (its prompts stay): a small AI step
that spends credits (get_status wait=true). Until it finishes,
change_type is refused (409). Sound effects and overlays always
survive; change an overlay's text with editor_edit scene_note. Later
segments may renumber: read the storyboard again.

action.description: combine: with_segment_number, optional keep; change_type: to, optional keep_image; rewrite: feedback

confirm.description: Run even though renders are lost; only after the user saw which

feedback.description: rewrite: what to change, e.g. "make this a close-up"

keep.description: combine: whose prompts and renders survive

keep_image.description: change_type from a clip to image: keep the rendered image

name: segment_restructure
title: Restructure a segment
